content:
This is an experimental project already built and deployed using Lean in wasm64/memory64. Main motivation for wasm64 was ofcourse using mathlib since mathlib doesn’t fit inside the 4 GB limit of wasm32. This project is built on top of https://github.com/cauli/lean4 + my modifications to work for wasm64 . So many thanks to the author (and also my AI assistant) 

Give it a run if you have chrome/firefox and good machine which has at least 8GB RAM. Safari does not support wasm64/memory64. Wasm64 does not have mmaps but still I think this is very decent performance. Working on improving it. I am hoping this will open up new use cases.

All proofs are elaborated and kernel-checked on your machine (in wasm64).

try it out ->   https://qed64.fawadworkaddress.workers.dev/
Source code :  https://github.com/FawadHa1der/QED64 (Continous deployment of the front end from github.)
